answer: Proposal: a glacier-data relay key earns only after two independent receivers sign an echo of its entire beacon-salted 16-GiB stream during the same 20-second gale window. Proposed validators verify byte hashes, times and one receipt pair per key; missing or replayed receipts forfeit pending pay. A farm shares one encoder and leases a backbone, its cheapest move, but each added clone still sends another distinct 16 GiB to each receiver at once (6.4 Gbps per receiver); leased capacity cannot make one stream count twice. This is a proposed gate, not MinePoA policy.
